candidates.intended_use: Inline small symbol on controlled backgrounds

padding_strategy.transparent_gold: 48px vertical and 136px horizontal minimum padding in a 512px square canvas
padding_strategy.dark_square_gold: 48px vertical and 136px horizontal minimum padding in a 512px square canvas
padding_strategy.dark_round_gold: 72px vertical and 150px horizontal minimum padding in a 512px circular canvas

background_strategy.transparent_gold: transparent; use only on controlled backgrounds
background_strategy.dark_round_gold: full circular Ink/Night background with transparent corners

limitations: The locked geometry may lose interior pen-nib and small diamond detail at 16px.
Transparent gold cannot guarantee contrast on arbitrary browser or operating-system backgrounds.
These candidates are neither approved masters nor production favicon or app-icon assets.
The review board is an SVG simulation; final rasterization behavior still requires later binary-export review.
review_checklist: Compare silhouette recognition at every simulated size.
Inspect the pen-nib opening and four small diamond details at 16px and 24px.
Compare contrast and edge clarity on transparent, square, and round backgrounds.
Select one direction before creating any master or binary export.
next_steps: Optionally create a separately documented simplified v0.2 if needed.
Lock a dedicated small-size master after approval.
Generate PNG, ICO, and app-icon binaries later through an approved manual or tooling workflow.
Handle runtime and public integration only in a later explicit pull request.
